thread_analysis.thread_summary: Howdy (contact Daisuke Oyamanai, on behalf of Fulltech) completes Bluetooth SIG registration with Allion (Itsuo Sakai, Masaya Iida). The thread covers final Review Page approval and Submission confirmation, followed by Compliance Folder (CD-R) delivery and a final closeout confirmation that the entire requested application process is complete.
all_questions_found: Does receiving the Compliance Folder (CD-R) mean the entire certification application process is complete? (see thread_0243_case_01)
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: Standard registration completion workflow: Review Page approval by the end customer (Fulltech, via Howdy) leads to Submission, followed by Compliance Folder CD-R production and delivery, with an explicit final confirmation that closes out the engagement.
thread_analysis.key_decision_logic: Engagement completion is marked by Compliance Folder delivery and retention, not by Submission alone.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Always provide an explicit final closeout confirmation when a customer asks whether an engagement is complete, to clearly end the active support relationship and set retention-only expectations going forward.
